events.did: told Gabriel he and Victor met at Lockland University, where Victor was top of the class until Eli transferred in sophomore year
events.quote_anchor: “We met at Lockland University,” he said. “Victor was top of the class. Until I transferred, sophomore year…”

events.did: remembered Angie with her arm around Victor’s waist, and described Victor as stern-faced and sharp and Angie as electric and ambitious
events.quote_anchor: Victor, stern-faced and sharp. Angie, electric and ambitious.

events.did: wanted to call himself a hero, but told Gabriel he was a wolf pretending to be a lamb
events.quote_anchor: A hero, he wanted to say. But he couldn’t seem to lie, even to himself.

events.did: recounted Victor sitting on the edge of the tub as Eli lowered himself into the icy water, and Victor’s envy when it had worked
events.quote_anchor: Victor, sitting on the edge of the tub as Eli lowered himself into the icy water.

events.did: admitted to killing Victor and said unfortunately it didn’t stick
events.quote_anchor: “I did,” said Eli grimly. “Unfortunately, it didn’t stick.”

events.did: recalled standing at the sink slicing himself open and watching the wounds heal again and again
events.quote_anchor: after Victor stormed off, and Eli stood at the sink, slicing himself open, watching the wounds heal again and again, horror mounting

events.did: named Sydney Clarke, said he tried to kill her once and that she brought Victor back a second time
events.quote_anchor: “Sydney Clarke,” he said, trying to keep the venom from his voice. “Short. Blond. Looks younger than she is?”

events.did: said Serena could command anyone to do anything using just her voice and that Sydney can resurrect the dead, like Gabriel
events.quote_anchor: Serena could command anyone to do anything, using just her voice. And Sydney can resurrect the dead. Like you.

relations.did: called Victor both a friend and a rival, remembering him at the college bar
relations.quote_anchor: Another memory—Victor sitting across from Eli at the college bar, those pale blue eyes hanging on him as he spoke his ideas into the world.

relations.did: let Eli pretend to be normal and was killed by Victor
relations.quote_anchor: Angie, who let him pretend to be normal.

relations.did: was the interloper and the new addition between Victor and Angie, not trying to edge Victor out
relations.quote_anchor: Even though that wasn’t true. Eli had been the interloper. The new addition. A wedge between the two of them.

relations.did: fell through the ice with her sister Serena and shot Eli through the heart
relations.quote_anchor: She’s the one who brought Victor back a second time.” And the one who shot me through the heart, he thought

numbers.did: counted to three before the pressure forced the answer out
numbers.quote_anchor: counted to three before the pressure forced the answer out.

numbers.who: the three of them (Eli, Victor and Angie)
numbers.did: were three, ranged around a café table
numbers.quote_anchor: The three of them, ranged around a café table. The three of them, heads bowed over their books, or laughing on the way to lab

numbers.did: is the one who brought Victor back a second time
numbers.quote_anchor: “I tried to kill her once, but she got away. She’s the one who brought Victor back a second time.”
